verdicts.reason: A is broken: the 'See the Schedule' button is cut off at the bottom edge and its label spills past the pill. The body copy is nearly as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy. The card fills the canvas edge to edge, so there are no margins and the confetti is reduced to a thin border. A also drops the legal line and leaves the logo squeezed into a corner beside the book. B keeps the book over the confetti on the left and a card on the right with a clear headline > body > CTA hierarchy and the legal text kept next to the button. B's flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo is tiny and barely legible, the book is undersized, the kicker floats top-right away from the logo, the legal text is cramped beside the CTA, and the card runs close to the top and bottom edges.
